en.t: Accession of Emperor Gaozong of Tang
en.s: Emperor Gaozong of Tang (21 July 628 – 27 December 683), personal name Li Zhi, was the third emperor of the Chinese Tang dynasty, ruling from 649 to 683; after January 665, he handed power over the empire to his second wife Empress Wu (the future Wu Zetian), and her decrees were carried out with greater force than the decrees of Emperor Gaozong.

zh.s: 唐高宗（628年7月21日—683年12月27日），名李治，是中国唐朝第三位皇帝，649年至683年在位。665年1月后，他将帝国权力交给第二任妻子武皇后（即后来的武则天）；武后的诏令比唐高宗的诏令更有力地得到执行。

en.s: The An Lushan rebellion was a civil war in China that lasted from 755 to 763, at the approximate midpoint of the Tang dynasty (618–907). It began as a commandery rebellion attempting to overthrow and replace the Tang government with the rogue Yan dynasty. The rebels succeeded in capturing the imperial capital Chang'an after the emperor had fled to Sichuan, but eventually succumbed to internal divisions and counterattacks by the Tang and their allies.
en.n: An Lushan Rebellion: Emperor Xuanzong of Tang is ordered by his Imperial Guards to execute chancellor Yang Guozhong by forcing him to commit suicide or face a mutiny. General An Lushan has other members of the emperor's family killed.

zh.s: 安禄山之乱是中国的一场内战，持续于755年至763年，发生在唐朝（618—907年）中期。最初，这场叛乱以郡级起兵为开端，意图推翻唐朝政府并另立燕朝。唐玄宗逃往四川后，叛军攻占都城长安，但最终因内部矛盾以及唐军和盟军的反攻而失败。
zh.n: 安禄山之乱：禁军逼迫唐玄宗赐死宰相杨国忠，否则将发动兵变；安禄山则杀害了皇帝家族的其他成员。

en.s: The siege of Jerusalem marked the successful end of the First Crusade, whose objective was the recovery of the city of Jerusalem and the Church of the Holy Sepulchre from Islamic control. The five-week siege began on 7 June 1099 and was carried out by the Christian forces of Western Europe mobilized by Pope Urban II after the Council of Clermont in 1095.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 耶路撒冷围城战标志着第一次十字军东征成功结束。十字军东征的目标是从伊斯兰势力手中夺回耶路撒冷及圣墓教堂。这场围城持续五周，于1099年6月7日开始，由西欧基督教军队发动。这些军队是在1095年克莱蒙宗教会议后，由教宗乌尔巴诺二世动员起来的。

en.s: In the Battle of Butaiha (or the Battle of Putaha) in July 1158, a Crusader army led by King Baldwin III of Jerusalem won a victory against the forces of Nur ad-Din Zengi, the emir of Aleppo and Damascus on the plains of Butaiha located in the northeast part of modern-day Israel. At the time of the battle, the area belonged to the Kingdom of Jerusalem.

zh.s: 1158年7月，耶路撒冷国王鲍德温三世率领十字军，在布泰哈平原击败了阿勒颇和大马士革埃米尔努尔丁·赞吉的军队。布泰哈平原位于今以色列东北部，战役发生时该地属于耶路撒冷王国。

en.s: The Battle of Belvoir Castle, also called the Battle of Le Forbelet, was a part of Saladin's campaign in May — August 1182 against the Crusaders. Crusader forces led by King Baldwin IV of Jerusalem battled with Ayyubid forces from Egypt commanded by Saladin. Saladin took action in Damascus on June 11, 1182, together with his regent Farrukh Shah.

zh.s: 贝尔沃城堡战役又称勒福贝莱战役，是萨拉丁于1182年5月至8月对十字军发动的一系列行动之一。耶路撒冷国王鲍德温四世率领十字军与萨拉丁指挥的埃及阿尤布军队交战。1182年6月11日，萨拉丁与其摄政法鲁赫·沙阿在大马士革采取行动。

en.s: The Battle of the Neva (Russian: Невская битва, romanized: Nevskaya bitva; Swedish: slaget vid Neva; Finnish: Nevan taistelu) was fought between the Novgorod Republic, along with Karelians, and the Kingdom of Sweden, including Norwegian, Finnish and Tavastian forces, on the Neva River, near the settlement of Ust-Izhora, on 15 July 1240. The battle is mentioned only in Russian sources, and it remains unclear whether it was a major invasion or a small-scale raid.

zh.s: 涅瓦河战役（俄语：Невская битва，转写：Nevskaya bitva；瑞典语：slaget vid Neva；芬兰语：Nevan taistelu）于1240年7月15日在涅瓦河畔、乌斯季伊若拉附近爆发。交战双方是诺夫哥罗德共和国及卡累利阿人，以及包括挪威、芬兰和塔瓦斯蒂亚部队在内的瑞典王国军队。该战役只见于俄罗斯史料，目前仍不确定这是一场大规模入侵还是小规模袭击。

en.s: The 1244 Siege of Jerusalem took place after the Sixth Crusade, when the Khwarezmians conquered the city on July 15, 1244.

zh.s: 第六次十字军东征结束后，花剌子模人在1244年7月15日攻占耶路撒冷。

en.s: The Peasants' Revolt, also named Wat Tyler's Rebellion or the Great Uprising, was a major uprising across large parts of England in 1381. The revolt had various causes, including the socio-economic and political tensions generated by the Black Death in the 1340s, the high taxes resulting from the conflict with France during the Hundred Years' War, and instability within the local leadership of London.
en.n: John Ball, a leader in the Peasants' Revolt, is hanged, drawn and quartered in the presence of King Richard II of England.

zh.s: 农民起义又称瓦特·泰勒起义或大起义，是1381年席卷英格兰许多地区的一场大规模起义。起义有多种原因，包括1340年代黑死病引发的社会经济和政治紧张、百年战争期间对法战争造成的高额税收，以及伦敦地方领导层不稳定。
zh.n: 农民起义领袖约翰·鲍尔在英格兰国王理查二世面前被处以绞刑、剖腹和分尸之刑。

en.s: The Battle of Grunwald, First Battle of Tannenberg or Battle of Žalgiris, was fought on 15 July 1410 during the Polish–Lithuanian–Teutonic War. The alliance of the Kingdom of Poland and the Grand Duchy of Lithuania, led respectively by King Władysław II Jagiełło (Jogaila) and Grand Duke Vytautas (Witold; Vitaŭt), decisively defeated the German–Prussian Teutonic Knights, led by Grand Master Ulrich von Jungingen. Most of the Teutonic Knights' leadership were killed or taken prisoner. Although defeated, the Teutonic Knights withstood the siege of their fortress in Marienburg (Malbork) and suffered minimal territorial losses at the Peace of Thorn (1411) (Toruń), with other territorial disputes continuing until the Peace of Melno in 1422.

zh.s: 格伦瓦尔德战役又称第一次坦能堡战役或萨尔吉里斯战役，于1410年7月15日在波兰—立陶宛—条顿战争期间爆发。波兰王国与立陶宛大公国结成同盟，分别由瓦迪斯瓦夫二世·雅盖沃国王和维陶塔斯大公率领，决定性地击败了乌尔里希·冯·荣金根大团长统率的德意志—普鲁士条顿骑士团。条顿骑士团多数高层战死或被俘。尽管战败，骑士团仍守住了马林堡（马尔堡）要塞；在1411年《托伦和约》中，骑士团领土损失不大，其他领土争端则持续至1422年《梅尔诺和约》。

en.s: The battle of Gozo was a naval battle between forces of Malta, then under the protection of the Order of Saint John, and the Ottomans. The battle took place on July 15, 1570, after four Maltese galleys encountered an Ottoman fleet under Uluj Ali. Three Maltese galleys were captured by the Ottomans, and one fled.

zh.s: 戈佐海战是马耳他与奥斯曼帝国之间的一场海战。当时马耳他处于圣约翰骑士团保护之下。1570年7月15日，4艘马耳他桨帆船遭遇乌鲁奇·阿里率领的奥斯曼舰队，双方交战。奥斯曼军俘获3艘马耳他船，另有1艘逃脱。

en.s: The Battle of Berlengas Islands was a naval battle which took place off the Portuguese coast on 15 July 1591, during the war between Elizabeth I of England and Philip II of Spain. It was fought between an English privateer squadron under George Clifford, 3rd Earl of Cumberland, who had set out his fortunes by large-scale privateering, and a squadron of 5 Spanish galleys commanded by Francisco Coloma tasked with patrolling the Portuguese coast against privateers.

zh.s: 1591年7月15日，英格兰伊丽莎白一世与西班牙腓力二世交战期间，双方在葡萄牙海岸外爆发贝伦加斯群岛海战。英方由坎伯兰第三代伯爵乔治·克利福德率领一支私掠船队；他靠大规模私掠活动积累财富。西班牙则派出弗朗西斯科·科洛马指挥的5艘桨帆船，在葡萄牙海岸巡逻并搜捕私掠船。

en.s: The Battle of Latarnia or Weichselsmünde was a surprise attack by Swedish artillery on a Polish fleet stationed outside Danzig at Weichselsmünde in 1628.

zh.s: 1628年，瑞典炮兵在但泽城外的魏克塞尔明德突袭一支波兰舰队，这场战斗又称魏克塞尔明德战役。

en.t: The first university of Finland, the Royal Academy of Turku, is inaugurated in Turku
en.s: The Royal Academy of Turku or the Royal Academy of Åbo was the first university in Finland, and the only Finnish university that was founded when the country still was a part of Sweden. It was founded in 1640. In 1809, after Finland became a grand duchy within the Russian Empire, it was renamed the Imperial Academy of Turku.

zh.t: 芬兰首所大学图尔库皇家学院在图尔库举行落成典礼
zh.s: 图尔库皇家学院又称奥博皇家学院，是芬兰第一所大学，也是芬兰仍属瑞典时创办的唯一一所大学。学院于1640年成立。1809年，芬兰成为俄罗斯帝国内的大公国后，学院更名为图尔库帝国学院。

en.s: The siege of Nakskov occurred from 4 May to 15 July 1659, during the Dano-Swedish War of 1658–1660. It began when an army of 2,000 men under Carl Gustaf Wrangel began blockading the roads leading into Nakskov. On 6 May, he would unsuccessfully attack towards Stubbeland and Färgeland after the garrison refused to surrender. Due to the failed attack, he instead began bombarding the city.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 纳克斯考围城战发生于1659年5月4日至7月15日，是1658至1660年丹麦—瑞典战争的一部分。卡尔·古斯塔夫·弗兰格尔率领2000人的军队封锁通往纳克斯考的道路，围城由此开始。5月6日，守军拒绝投降后，他试图进攻斯图贝兰和法尔格兰，但未能成功，随后转而炮击该城。

en.t: Baruch Laibov and Alexander Voznitsyn are burned alive in St. Petersburg, Russia. Vonitzin had converted to Judaism with Laibov's help, with the consent of Empress Anna Ivanovna
en.s: Baruch Leibov was a Jewish merchant who was burnt to death at the stake in St. Petersburg, Russia on July 15, 1738, for proselytizing.

zh.t: 巴鲁克·莱博夫和亚历山大·沃兹尼岑在俄罗斯圣彼得堡被活活烧死；在安娜·伊凡诺芙娜女皇同意下，沃兹尼岑在莱博夫帮助下改信犹太教
zh.s: 巴鲁克·莱博夫是一名犹太商人，1738年7月15日因传教改宗而在俄罗斯圣彼得堡被绑在火刑柱上烧死。

en.s: The Battle of Kazan (1774) was a major battle during Pugachev's Rebellion. It took place on 12–15 July 1774 in Kazan, Russia, and the surrounding area. The first stage began in the morning of 12 July, when rebels under Yemelyan Pugachev defeated government troops and besieged them in the Kazan Kremlin. During the battle some government forces defected to the rebels' side.

zh.s: 喀山战役是普加乔夫起义期间的一场重要战役，于1774年7月12日至15日在俄罗斯喀山及周边地区进行。第一阶段于7月12日上午打响，叶梅利扬·普加乔夫率领的起义军击败政府军，并将其围困在喀山克里姆林宫内。战斗中，部分政府军倒戈加入起义军。

en.s: The Battle of Lindley's Fort (July 15, 1776) was part of a campaign by Loyalist and Cherokee forces to gain control over the South Carolina backcountry from Patriot forces early in the American Revolutionary War. The Cherokees were involved because ongoing encroachment of their territory in the area had led them to take up arms. These activities prompted settlers to seek refuge at Lindley's Fort in present-day Laurens County. A joint force of Cherokee and Loyalists adorned with Indian warpaint descended on the fort one day after about 150 militiamen arrived at the stockade fort.

zh.s: 林德利堡战役发生于1776年7月15日，是美国独立战争初期效忠派与切罗基人试图从爱国派手中夺取南卡罗来纳州内陆控制权的一场行动。由于当地人不断侵占切罗基人的领地，他们也拿起武器参战。战事促使居民逃到今劳伦斯县的林德利堡避难。约150名民兵抵达木栅堡一天后，一支脸上涂着战纹的切罗基人与效忠派联军袭击了堡垒。

en.s: The Battle of Kaipiais took place on July 15, 1789 during Russo-Swedish War (1788–90), between Sweden and the Russian Empire. The Swedes lost the battle and had to withdraw with a loss of 265 men.

zh.s: 凯皮艾宁战役于1789年7月15日在俄瑞战争（1788—1790年）期间爆发，交战双方是瑞典和俄罗斯帝国。瑞典军战败撤退，损失265人。

en.s: The action of 15 July 1798 was a minor naval battle of the French Revolutionary Wars, fought off the Spanish Mediterranean coast by the Royal Navy ship of the line HMS Lion under Captain Manley Dixon and a squadron of four Spanish Navy frigates under Commodore Don Felix O'Neil.

zh.s: 1798年7月15日，法国大革命战争期间，英国皇家海军“雄狮号”战列舰与西班牙海军在西班牙地中海沿岸附近交战。英国舰船由曼利·迪克森海军上校指挥；西班牙方面则有费利克斯·奥尼尔海军准将率领的4艘护卫舰。

en.t: The Rosetta Stone is found in the Egyptian village of Rosetta by French Captain Pierre-François Bouchard during Napoleon's Egyptian Campaign
en.s: The Rosetta Stone is a stele of granodiorite inscribed with three versions of a decree issued in 196 BC during the Ptolemaic dynasty of Egypt, on behalf of King Ptolemy V Epiphanes. The top and middle texts are in Ancient Egyptian using hieroglyphic and Demotic scripts, respectively, while the bottom is in Ancient Greek. The decree has only minor differences across the three versions, making the Rosetta Stone key to deciphering the Egyptian scripts.

zh.t: 法军上尉皮埃尔-弗朗索瓦·布沙尔在拿破仑远征埃及期间，于埃及拉希德村发现罗塞塔石碑
zh.s: 罗塞塔石碑是一块粒玄岩石碑，上面刻有三种版本的法令。法令于公元前196年埃及托勒密王朝时期以托勒密五世·厄庇法涅斯国王的名义颁布。上方和中间的文字分别用古埃及象形文字和世俗体书写，下方则是古希腊文。三种版本只有细微差异，因此罗塞塔石碑成为破译埃及文字的关键。

en.s: The action of 15 July 1805 was a small naval action that took place off Chausey, on the coast of Normandy, involving two British gun-brigs on one side, and vessels on the other. The becalmed gun-brigs became easy targets for the row-powered gunboats, which were able to manoeuver as to overpower them and force their surrender.

zh.s: 1805年7月15日，诺曼底海岸外肖塞群岛附近发生一场小规模海战，交战双方是一支由两艘英国炮舰组成的船队和对方船只。英国炮舰因无风而无法航行，成为划桨炮艇的容易目标。炮艇机动灵活，压制了英国炮舰并迫使其投降。

en.s: The Pike Expedition (July 15, 1806 – July 1, 1807) was a military party sent out by President Thomas Jefferson and authorized by the United States government to explore the south and west of the recent Louisiana Purchase. It was led by United States Army Lieutenant Zebulon Pike, Jr. who was promoted to captain during the trip.

zh.s: 派克远征（1806年7月15日至1807年7月1日）是一支军事探险队，由托马斯·杰斐逊总统派出并经美国政府授权，探索新近购入的路易斯安那地区南部和西部。探险队由美国陆军中尉小泽布隆·派克率领，他在途中晋升为上尉。

en.s: The Battle of Obilești was fought in Obilești (now Valea Argovei), Wallachia (now Romania), between Russia and the Ottoman Empire as a part of the Napoleonic Wars during the Russo-Turkish War of 1806–1812.

zh.s: 奥比莱什蒂战役发生在瓦拉几亚的奥比莱什蒂（今罗马尼亚瓦莱亚·阿尔戈韦），交战双方是俄罗斯和奥斯曼帝国。此战属于1806至1812年俄土战争，也是拿破仑战争的一部分。

en.s: The siege of Izmail was a military operation took place Spring–Summer 1807 during the Eighth Russo-Turkish War. The Russians besieged the fortress of Izmail on the Danube. They were unable to break its resistance until the conclusion of a truce (the Tilsit peace negotiations also demanded a cessation of actions against Turkey) and were forced to retreat.

zh.s: 第八次俄土战争期间，俄军于1807年春至夏季围攻多瑙河畔的伊兹梅尔要塞。这场军事行动最终未能攻破要塞；停战协定达成后，俄军被迫撤退。《提尔西特和约》谈判也要求停止对土耳其的军事行动。

en.t: A fire destroys the ancient Basilica of Saint Paul Outside the Walls in Rome, Italy
en.s: The Papal Basilica of Saint Paul Outside the Walls (Italian: Basilica Papale di San Paolo fuori le Mura, Latin: Basilica Sancti Pauli extra mœnia) is one of Rome's four major papal basilicas, along with the basilicas of Saint John in the Lateran, Saint Peter's, and Saint Mary Major, as well as one of the city's Seven Pilgrim Churches. The basilica is the conventual church of the adjacent Benedictine abbey.

zh.t: 意大利罗马城墙外圣保禄大殿被大火焚毁
zh.s: 城墙外圣保禄宗座大殿（意大利语：Basilica Papale di San Paolo fuori le Mura；拉丁语：Basilica Sancti Pauli extra mœnia）是罗马四座主要宗座大殿之一，与拉特朗圣若望大殿、圣伯多禄大殿和圣母大殿并列，也是罗马七座朝圣教堂之一。该大殿是毗邻本笃会修道院的修院教堂。

en.s: The Battle of Aong took place on July 15, 1857, during the Indian rebellion of 1857, between the East India Company forces and Nana Sahib's forces. The East India Company forces under the command of General Sir Henry Havelock were advancing to Kanpur (Cawnpore), which had been besieged by Nana Sahib, supported by the rebel Company sepoys.

zh.s: 昂格战役于1857年7月15日在印度民族起义期间爆发，交战双方是东印度公司军队和纳纳·萨希卜的部队。亨利·哈夫洛克爵士将军率领东印度公司军队向坎普尔（旧称坎波尔）推进；该城当时遭到纳纳·萨希卜及反叛的东印度公司印度士兵围困。

en.s: The 1888 eruption of Mount Bandai was a major volcanic eruption which occurred during the Meiji period of the Empire of Japan. The eruption occurred on July 15, 1888, and pyroclastic flows buried villages on the northern foot of the mountain, and devastated the eastern part of Bandai region, Fukushima Prefecture north of Tokyo. At least 477 people were killed and hundreds more were injured and rendered homeless in what became the worst volcanic disaster in recent Japanese history. The eruption had many similarities to the 1980 eruption of Mount St. Helens in the United States.

zh.s: 1888年磐梯山喷发是日本明治时期的一次大规模火山喷发，发生于1888年7月15日。火山碎屑流掩埋了山北麓的村庄，并重创东京以北福岛县磐梯地区东部。至少477人遇难，另有数百人受伤或无家可归，成为日本近代史上最严重的火山灾害。此次喷发与美国圣海伦火山1980年的喷发有许多相似之处。

en.s: The Paraguayan Civil War was a civil war fought in Paraguay from 15 July 1911 to 11 May 1912. It started when members of the Liberal Party, led by Eduardo Schaerer and former president Manuel Gondra revolted against the rule of Liberato Marcial Rojas, and against major Albino Jara. It ended when Albino Jara was ambushed and killed near Paraguarí, allowing Eduardo Schaerer to assume the role of the 25th President of Paraguay.

zh.s: 巴拉圭内战从1911年7月15日持续到1912年5月11日。自由党成员在爱德华多·沙埃雷尔和前总统曼努埃尔·贡德拉的领导下，反抗利贝拉托·马西亚尔·罗哈斯的统治以及少校阿尔比诺·哈拉。战争以哈拉在巴拉瓜里附近遭伏击身亡告终，沙埃雷尔随后出任巴拉圭第25任总统。

en.s: The first election under the Seventeenth Amendment to the United States Constitution was a late election held on July 15, 1913. en.s: The Parliament of Poland is the bicameral legislature of Poland. It is composed of an upper house (the Senate) and a lower house (the Sejm). Both houses are accommodated in the Sejm and Senate Complex in Warsaw. The Constitution of Poland does not refer to the Parliament as a body, but only to the Sejm and Senate. en.t: The Japanese Communist Party is established in Japan
en.s: The Japanese Communist Party (日本共産党, Nihon Kyōsan-tō; abbr. JCP) is a major political party in Japan. Founded in 1922, it is the oldest active political party in the country. It had 250,000 members as of January 2024, making it one of the largest non-governing communist parties in the world. zh.s: 日本共产党（日语：日本共産党；罗马字：Nihon Kyōsan-tō；简称JCP）是日本主要政党之一。该党成立于1922年，是日本现存历史最悠久的政党。截至2024年1月，党员人数为250,000人，是世界上规模最大的非执政共产党之一。田村智子担任该党主席；她于2024年1月接替长期担任党魁的志位和夫。

en.s: The July 15 Incident (Chinese: 七一五事变), known by the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) as the July 15 counter-revolutionary coup (Chinese: 七一五反革命政变), and as the Wuhan–Communist split (Chinese: 武汉分共) by the Kuomintang (KMT), occurred on 15 July 1927. en.s: The Battle of Be'erot Yitzhak was a military engagement between the Israel Defense Forces and Egyptian army in the 1948 Arab–Israeli War. It was fought on July 15, 1948, in the ten-day period between the first and second truces of the war. The Egyptian army, after unsuccessful attacks on Negba on July 12 and Gal On on July 14, assaulted the lightly defended outlying Negev village Be'erot Yitzhak. They managed to penetrate the village perimeter, but the Israelis concentrated in an inner position in the village, and fought off the Egyptian advance until reinforcements arrived and drove out the attackers.
